laws.rule: In the land core of the Calanques National Park (the walking area around Marseille and Cassis), the park lists as prohibited: smoking or lighting a fire, including at the water's edge and including barbecues and camp stoves; bivouacking, camping and caravanning; and picking flowers, damaging trees or taking species. Dogs must be on a lead.
laws.heading: Parc national des Calanques, good practice and regulations (land core)

laws.rule: Flying a drone or model aircraft is prohibited in both the land core and the marine core of the Calanques National Park.
laws.heading: Parc national des Calanques, good practice and regulations

laws.rule: In the marine core of the Calanques National Park, sailing, anchoring or landing in the restricted zones is prohibited, as is taking protected species or underwater cultural property. A 5-knot speed limit applies within 300 metres of the coast.
laws.heading: Parc national des Calanques, good practice and regulations (sea)

laws.rule: The park runs a reservation system for the Sugiton calanque (a cove near Marseille) in summer; the park's own Sugiton reservation page is the place to book and to check the season's dates, which are set each year. The park page's rules text was not readable in full on 6 November 2026, so the dates and quota are not stated here.
laws.heading: Parc national des Calanques, Réservation Sugiton
